notes.title: Bug Fixes 8-19-2024
notes.content:
We've updated a few of the bugs you found in this new build:


 The web CGs disappear when they're supposed to
 If you got "Image such and such not found" in place of animations for the final battle, that should be taken care of.
 An important note on this one though: if you have old save files from before this fix was published, the glitch might still happen there 
 Eating the skull no longer causes a crash


Thank you so much for playing our demo!

notes.title: Happy Pride Month! Development Update
notes.content:
Hello, lovely people! Hoping you are having an amazing start to Pride Month. We know we are well, and we are going to tell you all about it today (an update was long overdue…)

So, let’s get started then!

General Development Update
It's been SO long since the last update, but we haven´t stopped with development. Far from that, we've been going back and forth through the Visual Novel and RPG aspects of the game to bring you a well balanced game at launch. This includes updated backgrounds, new character sprites, an upcoming trailer (pretty soon) and an upcoming demo (hopefully available by Q3 of 2024...).

We’ll also be at Flamecon 2024 this August! The event will be on Saturday 17th and Sunday 18th at the Times Square Sheraton in New York City. More information can be found on Flamecon’s Website, which you can find through this link: https://www.flamecon.org/ . More on this soon, but hoping to see you there!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42824168/1a2d868ec8ff8a7ab9a9e1d44a79565295cb1850.jpg

Love, the Yurisoft Games Team.

notes.title: Happy Pride Month from the Yurisoft Games!
notes.content:
https://64.media.tumblr.com/fe1c9aa386d8957de2e17254d55b24b5/a389b7408dc12c7c-fb/s640x960/8c6a1d7998b344983ff4b24f95cbf214692d4af8.pnj

First, a little graphic so you can see where we are, since last Update was on October! Things are looking like this:

https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1105909371289993257/1112819657204830258/The_Songbird_Guild_Development_Progress.png?width=1620&height=911

First of all, we are now in the Minimum Viable Product Milestone Phase. For this part of our process, our goals are to have:


 A full rough draft of the story
 The staging for Episode 1
 All Concept Art (which is done!!)
 Animations for Episode 1
 Character Portraits (which is almost done!!!!)
 Basic UI
 Rough Battle System in progress


We will update you monthly on how these things go, so no worries. Let us know what you want to see more of!

Thank you for your reading until the end! It really supports us in the development journey.

Love,

the Yurisoft Games Team
